label: README.md:1408's "seven project runtime configs" is a file count, not a doctor-managed count: /doctor:mcp install accepts --runtime from six names (opencode, claude, codex, cursor, pi, devin) and the doc has no dsh or vibe reference, while the seventh registration is DSH's hand-authored opt-in patch

Vibe is the only one of the eight runtimes with no Code Mode registration; .vibe/config.toml has zero mcp matches and Vibe's only MCP-adjacent surface is the mcp-route-guard plugin. Whether Vibe supports MCP natively was not established from repository evidence

All seven registrations mount the same code_mode server through node .skilled/bin/mcp-code-mode-launcher.cjs with UTCP_CONFIG_FILE=.utcp_config.json, in four config dialects: JSON mcpServers (Claude, Cursor, Devin), JSON mcpServers plus transport/lifecycle (Pi), JSON mcp with type local and environment (OpenCode), TOML mcp_servers.code_mode (Codex), YAML insert patch (DSH). Root .mcp.json is a symlink to .claude/mcp.json, not an eighth registration

.utcp_config.json is git-tracked, ships exactly 14 manual_call_templates and holds environment references rather than secrets: FIGMA_API_KEY, GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN, NOTION_TOKEN, OBSIDIAN_API_KEY, OBSIDIAN_BASE_URL, OBSIDIAN_VERIFY_SSL, WEBFLOW_TOKEN. This confirms README.md:1487's 14-template claim exactly

DSH's MCP patch resolves the checkout root from its own --patch argument rather than the cwd and bounds startup at 60 s; .dsh/SYNC.md records that dsh strips ambient KEY/PASSWORD/SECRET/TOKEN variables and picks Node 24 via NVM_DIR or $HOME/.nvm, and that the patch is never part of a default dispatch

The two only-registered-server claims survive measurement: code_mode is the only entry in all seven configs and opencode.json carries no skill-advisor registration, so README.md:1465 and README.md:676 can be kept as written

README.md:164's "You need Node.js 24" is a safe simplification of the nine-package range but should name its intersection: Code Mode's launcher refuses interpreters outside the server manifest range, and .codex/config.toml records that isolated-vm has no Node 25+ build and segfaults at isolate creation
Every Code Mode registration in this repository launches the same launcher with the same UTCP config file; no runtime registers a second MCP server
